reason: I ask Claude what to do and then I place the trades myself, and that's on purpose. A cartoon pet moving my real money through a broker partner nobody has named yet, at a price nobody has set, is not something I'd sign up for on my commute.
objection: Who's liable if the agent loses money? Limits and a kill switch are nice, but a downloadable record just proves what went wrong after the fact. It doesn't tell me who makes me whole.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the account, with a plain written answer on who covers losses if the agent breaks my own limits.
